_source: Transcribed field-by-field from the actual captured stdout of the final validated run (LLM_PROVIDER=groq GROQ_MODEL=llama-3.3-70b-versatile, run_ai_supervised_loop.py, all 4 validation checks active) -- copied directly from that run's tool output, not reconstructed from memory afterward. No log FILE was written to disk by that run itself -- logging is stdout-only by design (see docs/architecture-notes.md) -- which is the real provenance gap: this JSON's source is a captured terminal transcript, not a program-written artifact. Verified complete and accurate against that transcript line-by-line on 2026-07-26 (found and fixed one omission: the proposal_window field on each chunk had been dropped from the first transcription pass). For stronger provenance than a transcript diff can offer, the run can be repeated with stdout redirected to a real log file (`python scripts/run_ai_supervised_loop.py > run.log`) -- not yet done, since the original run's exact LLM outputs cannot be re-obtained verbatim (LLM responses are not guaranteed deterministic across calls), only reproduced in pattern. If the underlying run is ever re-executed, this file should be regenerated from that log file directly rather than re-transcribed by hand.
